summary.title: Add localization and Treatments UI tweaks
changes: New explanatory text was added describing upload of CGM sensor states and notes to Nightscout.
New text clarifies that uploading requires Allow Uploading to Nightscout and notes Dexcom G6 and G7 support.
The Fat-and-Protein order-change banner now has an orange background, a dismiss button, and a fade transition.
The banner's dismiss button now includes an accessibility label for screen readers.
The Time and Notes rows in the Treatments screen were adjusted to improve layout and divider rendering.
